name: goodwill-mcp
description: Log thrift-store donations from a receipt and item photos, with Form 8283 rows. Not affiliated with Goodwill Industries.
long_description: Drop your receipt and item photos in a folder and ask Claude to log the drop-off. Items are priced from a published thrift-shop price guide, stored in one SQLite file on your machine, and rolled up into Form 8283 Section A rows. Reports fair market value donated, never tax saved. Not tax advice.

inbox.title: Donation inbox folder
inbox.description: Where you drop receipt and item photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

tools.name: intake_open
tools.description: Read the receipt and item photos from the inbox.

tools.name: donation_create
tools.description: Log a donation and price its items.

tools.name: donation_update
tools.description: Correct or void a donation, with a revision trail.

tools.name: donation_report
tools.description: Year totals, CSV, Form 8283 rows, donor-portal text.

prompts.name: log_donation
prompts.description: Read the inbox photos and log the donation.
prompts.text: Log my donation: call intake_open, read the receipt and items, then call donation_create.
